source.title: A Case of Type 2 Hereditary Angioedema With SERPING1 Mutation.

confirmation.summary: Low C4, high C1-INH level with low C1-INH activity, and a confirmed SERPING1 mutation.
evidence: she presented with a very high C1-INH level (81.0 mg/dL; normal range: 21.0-39.0 mg/dL) and abnormally low C1-INH activity
The SERPING1 gene mutation was confirmed in this

note.text: Every few weeks my hands, thighs or feet swell up without a clear injury. Sometimes I get strong stomach pain during an attack. The swelling can last more than a day before it goes away on its own. My attacks became more frequent after I started a stressful job. Once my throat swelled and I had trouble breathing, and ordinary allergy medicine did not help.
note.author: T33 hand-off (assistant-written from the article; not the patient's words)

phenotypes.label: Angioedema
phenotypes.evidence: she had experienced migrating soft tissue swelling in both hands, thighs, and feet twice monthly

phenotypes.label: Edema
